title: Port Config
description: Port info for a TreeFrogUI port collection entry (ports/<id>/config.json).

safeRelativePath.description: Non-empty, not absolute, and no '..' path segments.

$schema.description: Path or URL to this schema, for editor tooling.

id.description: Must also match the port's directory name and be unique across ports.

launcher.description: Root-level .sh filename (no path separators). Must be unique across ports.

binary.description: Port-local little-endian 32-bit MIPS ELF, relative to the port directory.

args.description: Command-line arguments passed to the binary.

content.description: Content file passed to the core. Must be packaged in the port directory or listed in required_file_sets.

required_file_sets.description: User-supplied game data groups. Empty array means no game data is required. Non-empty means a .requires_game_data marker must exist.

setup_guide.description: Repo-root-relative path to a checked-in guide.
